title: Balloons Above

services.name: Hot Air Balloon Rides
services.desc: Balloons Above provides you with an unforgettable experience! Book hot air balloon flights with us to experience Summit County from the sky-including must-see areas of Park City, Midway, Heber City, and Kamas. Whether you’re celebrating a wedding, birthday or other special event, or are looking for an amazing tourism experience, we’ll make sure you enjoy every moment of the hot air balloon journey. Most balloon rides are scheduled in the morning and early afternoon. Our hot air balloon company is also one of the most convenient for those with mobility issues. All baskets are easily accessible-meaning there is a door to get in and out, instead of requiring you to climb over the edge. Book
